verdict.rationale: Featurebase has no documented 'product specification' artifact, but a developer could approximate the workflow: status-change webhooks notify backend systems, and the Posts API returns feedback submissions that could feed delivery tooling. Generic integration claims do not name any delivery or issue tracker. missing for 10: a spec/PRD object with an approval state, a documented push or sync to delivery tools (e.g. Jira/Linear/GitHub), an end-to-end feedback-to-implementation workflow guide, and independent corroboration.
